operating_entities.note: The page lists all 13 companies flat under The Co-operators Group Limited; it does not show the intermediate holding company (Co-operators Financial Services Limited) or percentage ownership, so none is added here. The page shows no CUMIS Life entity (CUMIS Life Insurance Company was amalgamated into Co-operators Life). The site's Legal page separately defines 'Co-operators' as 'Co-operators Group Limited and any of its related, affiliated and subsidiary corporations, including... Co-operators General Insurance Company, Co-operators Life Insurance Company, HB Group Insurance Management Ltd., Federated Agencies Limited, Co-operators Financial Services Limited, CUMIS General Insurance Company, The Sovereign General Insurance Company, The Edge Benefits Inc., Co-operators Financial Investment Services Inc. and Premier Marine Insurance Managers Group (West) Inc.' (https://www.cooperators.ca/en/security-privacy/legal) - recorded for reference, not merged into the list.

ceo.name: Rob Wesseling
ceo.title: President and Chief Executive Officer, The Co-operators Group Limited
ceo.entity: The Co-operators Group Limited (group parent; Co-operators Life lists no separate President)
ceo.prior: Career at Co-operators: joined 1997 as application architect; COO The Sovereign General 2007-2016; EVP National P&C Operations 2011-2016; Chair ICMIF
ceo.tenure_source: press release (CEO effective 2016-12-01, investmentexecutive.com); company bio / MarketScreener (joined 1997)
ceo.note: Co-operative: no proxy circular, no pay disclosed. Also a director of Addenda Capital. Day-to-day head of the insurer is Alec Blundell, FCIA, FSA - Executive Vice-President & Chief Operating Officer, Co-operators Life Insurance Company and CUMIS (seat since 2019-03-18; joined CUMIS 1994; moved to Co-operators Life 2010; VP Individual Insurance & Chief Actuary 2013; tenure_source: press release 2019-03-11 and executive profile). Blundell is kept out of other_leaders to respect the CFO/CRO/asset-manager-head limit.

cio.name: Ian A. McKinnon, CFA
cio.title: Chief Investment Officer, Addenda Capital Inc.
cio.entity: Addenda Capital Inc. (wholly owned group asset manager; manages the Co-operators Life general account)
cio.reports_to: Roger Beauchemin, President & CEO, Addenda Capital (stated by Benefits and Pensions Monitor company profile); Addenda in turn 'reports to Co-operators as its sole owner'
cio.prior: Addenda Capital fixed-income portfolio manager; Head of Fixed Income Investments 2014-2016; Executive Vice-President, Core Fixed Income from 2018 (Desjardins newsletter); responsible for Core Fixed Income and Preferred Shares strategies and balanced asset allocation
cio.tenure_source: MarketScreener insider experience page (CIO start 2024-01-01) and Form ADV-derived profile ('since 2024') - aggregators; no Addenda appointment release found; Addenda leadership page confirms current title
cio.note: Most senior investment officer for the insurer's general account: Co-operators Life publishes no CIO or VP Investments of its own; the IAR states the group's assets are managed 'through our asset management company Addenda Capital Inc.' and CGIC's financial report says the majority of the portfolio is managed by Addenda on fees 'consistent with external clients'. Oversight inside the co-operative sits with the Management Investment Committee under the Board Risk Committee (IAR 2025). firm_since null: round-1 'since c.2000' could not be sourced.

gaps: Co-operators Life itself names no investment officer; the CIO shown is Addenda Capital's. Which Co-operators officer chairs the Management Investment Committee that oversees the Addenda mandate is not disclosed (searched executive-team page, IAR 2025, CGIC financial report, web).

Addenda publishes no team page with reporting lines or bios; direct reports were assembled from Addenda's four investment-solutions pages and leadership page, so all eight are 'inferred from title'. One is 'stated' only at the CIO level (McKinnon reports to Beauchemin, per Benefits and Pensions Monitor).

Tenure: LinkedIn not accessible; MarketScreener pages return 403 to direct fetch, so dates come from search snippets of aggregators. Null tenure fields: McKinnon firm/industry; Stilo seat; Pelland seat; Warren, Chafee, Kapala, Laliberte, Robert, Kot all three dates; Higgins industry_since; Wesseling none; Beauchemin none.

notes: Entities page lists 13 companies flat under The Co-operators Group Limited; the insurer and its asset manager are siblings, not parent/child. Addenda Capital (Montreal/Toronto/Guelph/Regina; C$42.5bn AUM; 170+ staff; 'over 50 investment professionals') manages the group's general accounts under annual arm's-length contracts; Addenda Executive Committee = Beauchemin (CEO), McKinnon (CIO), Boudreau (EVP Business Development), Leblanc (COO), Gosselin (EVP Talent), Kot (EVP Commercial Mortgages).
